qa_pairs.question: What are the torque angles specified for the 5AZ cylinder head bolts?
qa_pairs.answer: 90 degrees for each torque angle step

qa_pairs.question: What is the warm-running time requirement for the 5AZ cylinder head bolts?
Which engine types use the 6AZ cylinder head bolt procedure?
qa_pairs.answer: M40/M42/M43/M44/M50/S50 US/S52/M52 with cast iron engine block

qa_pairs.question: What important instruction is given for M52 aluminum block cylinder head bolts?
qa_pairs.answer: Fit new cylinder head bolts. Do not wash away coating on cylinder head screws
